why: The student says the indented println("done") is inside the braceless if, but in Java only the next single statement is the body, so the answer rests on a wrong rule. The correct output for java Order 3 is "start" then "done". The answer says nothing about java Order five, which throws a NumberFormatException at parseInt before anything is printed.

concepts.quote: Only start, because done is inside the if and 3 is not > 5
concepts.why: The student reads the indentation as if it set the scope, but without braces the body of an if is only one statement, so done prints anyway.
